releases.name: v0.1.0 — OpenCode v2 support
releases.body:
## v0.1.0 — OpenCode v2 support

The `main` line is now built for the OpenCode 2 plugin API.

### Breaking
- Requires **OpenCode 2.0.20+**. On OpenCode 1.x the host's `engines.opencode`
  check refuses to load this version — stay on `0.0.3` (frozen `v1` branch).

### What's new
- Dual-surface plugin: server entry (`.`) purges session tasks on `session.deleted`;
  TUI entry (`./tui`) provides the live "My Backlog" sidebar panel.
- Six dialog-driven commands (`/todo-add`, `/todo-run`, `/todo-remove`,
  `/todo-edit`, `/todo-list`, `/todo-clear`) via TUI keymap commands — in `/`
  autocomplete and the command palette, no stubs, no model turns.
- Session-scoped tasks with per-session numbering and confirmation-based clear.
- New demo recording (Solarized Light), shipped in the npm tarball.

Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-todo`
